observations: The page number «43» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «6*» on the right. L23-L24: the heading of chapter 8, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L04-L08: the addition at the end of chapter 7 (p. 9 of the text, JP2 0041). Checked: 360 × 66⅔ = 24000 miles; at 1973 m (L12) these are 47 352 km, and 360 × 56⅔ = 20 400 miles are 40 249 km; 4000 camel paces to a mile of about 2000 m (L16-L17) are paces of half a metre, which Suter calls suspicious.

L27: the apogee of the sun, 77° 55′, as in chapter 8 of the text (p. 9, JP2 0041, L17: two signs 17° 55′). N05-N08: in the letters of the abjad 55 is nūn hāʾ and 15 yāʾ hāʾ, two letters that differ in their dots when joined.

L09: the paragraph is indented 30 px more than the others of the page (its first ink at x 337, where L01 and L14 begin at 307 and 311). L07: after «Erde» a faint mark like a closing bracket, much lighter than the print; not transcribed. L11: «dhirāʿ», «aṣbaʿ», «iṣbaʿ» in italics, the ʿayn upright and raised. L12: «al-Ma’mūn» spaced; L14 «Chasles»; N07 «Ibn Hibintās», with the macron, «Batt.»; N08 «Nallino». L22: „a Caldeis“ „arabice“, two quotations in German quotation marks.
N01 and N03: the titles in italics, the rest upright; N02 «1892—93», «I—IV», the long dash set close.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-12 px measured).
